content.title: Second London Baptist Confession of Faith (1677, reissued 1689)
content.author: 1689 Baptist Confession · Particular Baptist elders in London, 1677; their General Assembly, 1689
content.note: The Baptist revision of the Westminster Confession, written by Particular (Calvinistic) Baptists in London in 1677 and adopted by their General Assembly in 1689. These guides cite it beside Westminster: the two agree on most doctrine and differ above all on the covenants, the church and baptism. Citations give chapter and paragraph; its numbering follows Westminster's closely but not exactly. The site's own doctrinal standard is the Baptist Faith and Message 2000, and Scripture judges every confession (1.10).

reviews.scope: Added the Second London Baptist Confession (1677/1689) beside Westminster: each 1689 chapter/paragraph locator checked against the site's pinned CC0 text (lwalen/lbcf) for existence and parallel meaning; Baptist Faith and Message 2000 article V wording checked at bfm.sbc.net; the 2012 Traditional Statement quoted from its text in the Journal for Baptist Theology and Ministry 9:2 (Fall 2012).
reviews.note: AI-assisted editorial review against the cited primary texts; not independent human theological approval. Implements StudyPlan section 7, item 1: Baptist parallels and, in the election answer, the non-Calvinist Southern Baptist reading with named holders.
